question: ______ is one of the recipients of the Ramon Magsaysay Award.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arvind Kejriwal**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2006,** Arvind Kejriwal was awarded the Ramon Magsaysay Award for Emergent Leadership**,
 
• It recognizes his involvement in a grassroots movement, **Parivartan**, using the Right to Information (RTI) to bring transparency and accountability to governance in India.
 
• It** effectively used the Right to Information (RTI) Act to expose **corruption and inefficient practices within government departments.
 
• Inspired by the success of Parivartan, Arvind Kejriwal later entered **mainstream politics. **
 
• **In 2012, he formed the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) to further his vision of clean governance and transparency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ramon Magsaysay Award is Asia’s highest honor, celebrates the greatness of spirit and transformative leadership in Asia.
 
• Ramon Magsaysay Award:
 
 
• The award was started in 1957.
 
• Founder: Ramon del Fierro Magsaysay, the third president of the Republic of the Philippines.
 
• Ramon Magsaysay Award is known as Asia's Nobel prize.
 
• It is the highest award given to Asian individuals and organizations.
 
• The awards have been given in six categories:
 
 
• Government service
 
• Public service
 
• Community leadership
 
• Journalism, Literature, Creative communication arts
 
• Peace and international understanding
 
• Emergent Leadership
 
 
 
• Awardees are presented with a certificate and a medallion with an embossed image of Ramon Magsaysay facing right in the profile.
 
• The Award is presented to awardees in formal ceremonies in Manila, the Philippines on 31st August every year.
 
• Vinobha Bhave was the 1st Indian to win the Ramon Magsaysay award.
